items.title: Document Review with Unsiloed and TypeSafe Jev
items.summary: 📝 Our extraction schema defines the fields Unsiloed should return for each medication. Each field has two Unsiloed confidence scores: extraction_score measures confidence in the extracted value, while grounding_score measures confidence that the value was located in the document. All six rows share one request, with each question evaluated independently.🔗 Read more: https://www.unsiloed.ai/blog/document-review-unsiloed-typesafe-jev

items.title: Hittite royal archive found in Turkey
items.summary: 📝 Archaeologists have uncovered a royal archive of cuneiform tablets in the ancient Hittite city of Samuha, modern-day Sivas, central Turkey. The cuneiform tablet records the funerary ritual that followed. The text also confirms that the king was at Samuha when the letter arrived, underscoring the city’s political importance.🔗 Read more: https://www.thehistoryblog.com/archives/77107
